  1. Archie for Business
  2. Install

Install Archie for Business.

An agent your team can message, running on one computer you own. A desktop app you download and open, not a website you log into.

Business build for Mac

macOS 12 Monterey or later, Apple silicon or Intel. Signed and notarized with Apple, so it opens the way any other app does.

Business build for Windows

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Windows will try to stop you the first time; the personal install page explains why, and it is the same warning.

Archie is in testing and not for sale yet (here’s what a business plan covers). Join the waitlist for launch news. The downloads above are testing builds; access depends on your account or trial eligibility. Public paid signup is closed.

Two apps

It installs beside the personal Archie.

A personal agent answers its owner. A business agent can answer everyone the owner lets in, each from their own mail and calendar. Archie for Business keeps its own data and its own keys under its own name, so one computer can run both and neither reads the other’s.

They are two apps and two plans, bought separately. What a shared agent does, and what a business plan costs.

The same for both editions

Three things that apply to either app.

Windows says “Windows protected your PC”

The blue box, why it appears on a build nobody has paid Microsoft to vouch for, how to get past it, and how to check the file yourself rather than take our word for it. Read the Windows warning on the Archie install page.

Your keys never reach us

Where your AI key and your connected accounts are kept, and what leaves the computer. Read about your keys on the Archie install page.

We’ll walk you through the install

If any of this goes sideways, a person answers. The ways to reach us are on the Archie install page.

Don’t rent your agent. Own it.
Yours to shape & yours to keep. Never ours.
